name: Into the Fire
detailed_description:
Embark on an eerie adventure in the shadow of a volcano, shooting fire demons and battling the fury of nature in Into the Fire, a disaster extraction survival game.

You are a bold explorer struggling to survive during a volcanic eruption on Dante’s Archipelago. With the world collapsing around you, you must rescue as many lives as possible through lava and ash. Navigate crumbling landscapes, outrun firestorms, and unearth secrets buried deep in the volcanic abyss—facing its demons and an onslaught of ever-shifting threats and strange anomalies that fuel the chaos.

Armed with unconventional weapons and tools—fire-extinguishing shotguns, seismic scanners, and retro-futuristic inventions—you must race against time to save lives while unraveling fiery myths, confronting enigmatic forces of nature, and uncovering dark rituals lurking within the inferno.

The Hub will be your sanctuary—a place to regroup, craft essential survival tools, upgrade gear, rest in a garden, choose the equipment that determines your playstyle and piece together the island’s ominous past. Beyond its walls, something terrifying is waiting.

The game’s world pulses with a distinct retro aesthetic, capturing the golden age of scientific ambition intertwined with folklore and the supernatural—offering a survival experience that leaves you breathless with every burning step.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • Shooter-style Extraction – Combat volcanic fire and mystical demons in the epicenter of a catastrophe to save "just one more life".

  • High-Stakes Rescue Gameplay – Feel the rush of being a first responder in an unfolding catastrophe, where every second counts and every choice has consequences.

  • Tactical Extinguishing Weapons – Wield unique tools like a suppression pistol, extinguishing shotgun, and fire bomb launcher to battle flames, fire phenomena and carve paths to safety.

  • Search the Ash-Covered Wasteland – Move through scorched ruins submerged in a post-apocalyptic atmosphere, using retro blowers and life-sign detectors. Someone may still be alive beneath the ash—and rare artifacts await those who dare to dig.

  • Dynamic and Diverse Disaster Environment – Face an ever-changing volcanic landscape where collapsing terrain, ash storms, pyroclastic flows and unpredictable eruptions force constant adaptation.

  • The Hub: A Living Base – More than just a shelter, the Hub is your strategic nerve center—plan rescues, gather intel, upgrade your arsenal, craft survival gear, and uncover the island’s darkest secrets. Or catch a breath in a garden.

  • Traversal & Mobility Focus – Use rope systems, retro sleds, and other tools to navigate treacherous terrain and reach those in need before time runs out.

  • Survival Through Strategy – Read seismographs, manage resources, and make tactical decisions to stay one step ahead of both natural and supernatural threats.

  • Fantastical Retro-Inspired Gadgets – Inspired by pioneering volcanologists, use experimental gear like unique retro vehicles, fireproof shields, and acid-resistant boats to survive the inferno.

  • Crafting Under Pressure – Scavenge resources and craft what you need to survive—and help others—in one of the world’s most extreme environments, including fire-extinguishing bombs, first aid kits, water tanks, and weapons.

  • Mystery & Myth Collide – As you fight to save lives, gather relics tied to ancient legends, uncover a force beyond science, and face the eerie adversaries lurking within the chaos.

  • Time as a Resource – Disaster is relentless—prioritize, act fast, and make sacrifices to ensure the survival of as many as possible.

Blending extinguisher shooter action, survival, gripping tales, and psychological depth, Into the Fire delivers an intense, genre-bending experience. You’ll be immersed in a hypnotic vision where science meets mysticism, pushing you to cross the gates of hell and save just one more life.

short_description: Battle nature's fury and combat fire demons in a disaster extraction survival set in the shadow of an erupting volcano. Wield tactical extinguisher weapons and fantastic retro inventions. Expand base, dive into mystical tales, rituals and unexplained phenomena, while rescuing people and animals.
